integrity: The proof is analytic with exact polynomial sign certification; finite substitutions corroborate but do not prove its infinite parameter statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only five equally spaced pentagonal normals and gamma=(t,t,1,1,t); Example 3.2 of arXiv:2610.21533 already gives t=4 and 3 solutions. Historical priority relative to unindexed work remains provisional.
title: Sharp one-to-three solution transition for a reflection-symmetric pentagonal cone-volume fiber
